summary: Master Roadmap Control Center and Investor Progress testing complete. All critical features verified: Admin can access /admin/master-roadmap without blank screen, launch readiness correctly shows NOT ready with open P0 tasks, task/gate/feature registry updates work via UI/API, /investors/progress loads with sanitized data (no customer data, credentials, or security details exposed), wallet consistency API contract intact with canonical_source metadata.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMasterRoadmapPage.jsx: Clean implementation with comprehensive data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
InvestorProgressPage.jsx: Properly sanitized view with disclosure policy clearly stating no customer data exposure
master_roadmap.py: Well-structured backend with proper admin auth checks, rate limiting on PATCH endpoints, and audit logging
wallet.py: Correctly returns canonical_source='users.balance' metadata in both /api/wallet and /api/wallet/balance endpoints
Launch readiness logic correctly prevents 'Launch Ready' status while P0 tasks remain open
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Roadmap Control Center testing complete: (1) /admin/master-roadmap loads without blank screen for admin users, (2) Launch readiness shows 'Nicht Launch Ready' with 4 open P0 tasks and 11 blocked gates, (3) Task status updates work via dropdown selects with all status options (Backlog, Ready, In Progress, Blocked, In Review, Testing, Manual Approval, Ready for Release, Completed, Rejected), (4) Release gate status updates work with options (verified, incomplete, blocked, manual-approval), (5) Feature registry toggles work for store_safe and enabled_in_web_production flags, (6) Final Acceptance Report table shows all features with Web/iOS/Android/Backend/Tests/Blocker/Beta columns, (7) /investors/progress loads with sanitized data - no customer emails, credentials, or security details exposed, (8) Wallet consistency API contract verified - both /api/wallet and /api/wallet/balance return canonical_source='users.balance' and same EUR balance, (9) Both pages responsive on mobile (390px) with no horizontal overflow. KYC remains disabled globally as expected.
